detailed_descriptions.en: SEKTORI Sektori is an intense, fast paced twin-stick shooter infused with hard hitting techno music. Choose your upgrades carefully and create powerful builds to take on the relentless enemies and epic bosses on a constantly evolving battlefield. Sektori is a game that requires your complete focus, a game where the high-adrenaline visuals, music, and gameplay come together to transport you into another state of consciousness. Simple, pure gameplay. Quick runs. Lots of challenge and replayability. FEATURES A five world campaign mode with dynamically changing levels and tons of enemy variation - including epic evolving bosses Alternate ships and configurable upgrade decks to mold your run with Three difficulty modes suited for all players, including a "Revolution" campaign mode for maximal challenge Six alternate game modes, like Classic, Gates and Assault Varied selection of challenges and medals to reach for DEVELOPER NOTES With Sektori I wanted to create a shoot'em up where every run feels familiar, but is still completely unique. A game of skill, not memorization. The hand crafted attack waves, levels and even the bosses are combined, randomized and layered with the upgrade systems in a way that creates an interesting challenge for every run. The aesthetics of the game are very much inspired by techno music. Fast, detailed, colorful, saturated, intense, aggressive. Dive in, take on the challenge as it comes and have fun! WARNING This game contains flashing lights that may make it unsuitable for people with photosensitive epilepsy or other photosensitive conditions. Player discretion is advised.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
SEKTORI

Sektori is an intense, fast paced twin-stick shooter infused with hard hitting techno music. Choose your upgrades carefully and create powerful builds to take on the relentless enemies and epic bosses on a constantly evolving battlefield. Sektori is a game that requires your complete focus, a game where the high-adrenaline visuals, music, and gameplay come together to transport you into another state of consciousness.

Simple, pure gameplay. Quick runs. Lots of challenge and replayability.

FEATURES

  • A five world campaign mode with dynamically changing levels and tons of enemy variation - including epic evolving bosses

  • Alternate ships and configurable upgrade decks to mold your run with

  • Three difficulty modes suited for all players, including a "Revolution" campaign mode for maximal challenge

  • Six alternate game modes, like Classic, Gates and Assault

  • Varied selection of challenges and medals to reach for

DEVELOPER NOTES

With Sektori I wanted to create a shoot'em up where every run feels familiar, but is still completely unique. A game of skill, not memorization. The hand crafted attack waves, levels and even the bosses are combined, randomized and layered with the upgrade systems in a way that creates an interesting challenge for every run. The aesthetics of the game are very much inspired by techno music. Fast, detailed, colorful, saturated, intense, aggressive.

Dive in, take on the challenge as it comes and have fun!

WARNING

This game contains flashing lights that may make it unsuitable for people with photosensitive epilepsy or other photosensitive conditions. Player discretion is advised.
